d:
Before India had epics, temples, kingdoms, or classical Sanskrit poetry, it had the Rigveda.
And in the Rigveda, few figures are as overwhelming as Indra: the storm-bringer, the breaker of forts, the slayer of Vritra, the one who releases the rivers and brings rain to the world.
This video is a cinematic reimagining of that ancient Indraic energy.
The Hindi lyrics come from *Bharat Ek Khoj*, where Rigvedic mantras were translated into powerful Hindi verse. I have tried to present them as a dark Vedic war anthem: grand, martial, terrifying, and devotional in the older sense of the word.
